_comment: RAG corpus binding for the Vendor Qualification & Risk Tiering agent. The corpus is the shared Sensei corpus used by the Supplier Contract Review workflow and already contains the National Holding Procurement Policy. It is deliberately NOT re-ingested or duplicated: pointing RAG_CORPUS at a dedicated corpus later is a one-variable change in agents/base_rag_agent.py.

retrieval_config._comment: 15 chunks is enough to span the Risk Scoring Matrix, the Mandatory High-Risk Classification list, and the Vendor Category Risk Treatment matrix in one pass. Matches the contract-review workflow.

generation_config._comment: Low temperature. The model writes narrative and cites policy; it never computes a score. Every number in the dossier is produced by risk_engine.py.

form.file_name: NH-PQF-001-Rev.09 - Vendor Prequalification & FTA Verification Form.xlsx

operational_notes: rag.list_files() on this corpus currently returns HTTP 429 (VertexRagDataService quota). Retrieval and grounded generation are unaffected, so corpus file listing is never on the request path.

If the corpus is ever rebuilt, the country risk tiers in the KYC and Due Diligence Policy (Appendix B) are still missing: the weighted matrix and the three client references are hardcoded in risk_engine.py and schemas.py and documented there as the single place to change them when the GCICD matrix is supplied.
